model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the F1 score evolution across epochs for three different methods: 'lattice', 'FLAT', and 'OURS'. The horizontal axis, labeled 'epouch (次)' (epoch), ranges from 0 to 18 in a linear scale with tick marks at every 2 units. The vertical axis, labeled 'F1分数' (F1 score), ranges from 0.55 to 0.90 in a linear scale with tick marks at every 0.05 units. The 'lattice' method is represented by a solid red line with square markers, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.59 at epoch 2 and increasing steadily to about 0.85 at epoch 16. The 'FLAT' method is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at an F1 score of approximately 0.79 at epoch 2 and rising to about 0.88 at epoch 16. The 'OURS' method is depicted by a solid yellow line with triangular markers, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.82 at epoch 2 and increasing to about 0.90 at epoch 16. All three lines show an overall increasing trend in F1 score as epochs progress.
